name: Sanctuary

header.Components: V, S, M (a shard of glass from a mirror)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

casting.material: a shard of glass from a mirror

authored_intent: Bonus Action ward creature; hostile attacker or damaging-spell caster WIS save or choose new target/lose attack/spell; area effects unaffected; ward ends on recipient attack, spell or damage.

rules.text: You ward a creature within range.

Until the spell ends, any creature who targets the warded creature with an attack roll or a damaging spell must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or either choose a new target or lose the attack or spell.
This spell doesn’t protect the warded creature from areas of effect.
The spell ends if the warded creature makes an attack roll, casts a spell, or deals damage.
